name: Bisexuals
overview: Scripture clearly defines sexual relations between men as sinful and an abomination before God, as stated in Leviticus 18:22 and 20:13. The narrative of Sodom in Genesis 19 and Ezekiel 16 highlights the broader moral failures linked to such acts, emphasizing pride and neglect of the needy rather than sexual behavior alone. Isaiah 56:3 reminds believers that God accepts all who join themselves to Him, regardless of physical condition or social standing. The teaching of Jesus in Matthew 7:12 calls for treating others with love and respect, reflecting God's holiness in our relationships.
